reason: The PR adds a Chvatal-Gomory strengthening rule to MIP row presolve. The author reports a small average effect over a broad MIP set, so this is an open solver-engineering opportunity and does not qualify as a positive expert reference.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: On bounded mixed-integer inequalities where scaled coefficient rounding strengthens the row, the new rule may reduce the feasible relaxation and later branch-and-bound work, at a presolve cost; rows with no accepted scalar should behave as controls.
causal_chain: The PR searches coefficient scalars, complements or shifts bounded variables, rounds coefficients and rhs while preserving validity, then adds a stronger presolve row. This can tighten the LP relaxation and alter dual bounds, node counts and proof time, while increasing row-processing work.
structural_trigger: A MIP inequality row with bounded integer variables and at least one accepted Chvatal-Gomory scalar; ranged rows, unbounded variables, nonintegral rows and rows with no strengthening are controls.
activation_probe: On both pinned builds, count eligible rows, scalar candidates, accepted strengthened rows, coefficient/rhs changes and resulting presolve rows; compare root bounds and search nodes on a frozen public trigger/control panel.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze binary knapsack and scheduling MIPs by row structure and baseline difficulty before hidden outcomes; include rows that satisfy and fail the rounding preconditions, fixed seeds and budgets, and retain all timeouts.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared HiGHS exact-MIP driver and direct row probes to show the strengthening rule executes on a public MIP; independently validate original-model solutions, bounds and statuses.
mathematical_risk: An invalid complement/shift or floating-point rounding could cut off feasible integer points, create false infeasibility, or invalidate bounds and optimality claims.
independent_check_plan: Check returned primal assignments against original constraints and integrality, compare dual bounds with independently proven optima, and test infeasible and normal-timeout statuses on tractable MIPs.
hidden_generalization_plan: Measure verified solved coverage, proof time and valid timeout-bound progress on held-out knapsack and scheduling MIPs, stratified by whether the row trigger occurs; report regressions and inactive cases.
overlap_review: HiGHS #2861 changes enumeration-based presolve, #3213 changes early branching budgets, and #651 changes primal heuristics at other snapshots. This PR’s CG row strengthening is a distinct presolve mechanism and one task across its two source files.
resource_risk: More row scans and stronger-row materialization can increase presolve time and memory; average search improvement may be small or absent when few rows meet the trigger.
